arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّ هذَيْن آيَتَانِ مِنْ آياتِكَ، وَهذَين عَوْنَانِ مِنْ أَعْوَانِكَ
transliteration: allāhumma innahā dhāni āyatānin min āyātika wa-hadha-yin ʿawnan min aʿwānika
english_text: O God, these are two of Thy signs and these are two of Thy helpers.

arabic_text: يَبْتَدِرَانِ طَاعَتَكَ بِرَحْمَة نَافِعَة أَوْ نَقِمَة ضَارَّة، فَلاَ تُمْطِرْنَا بِهِمَا مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ، وَلا تُلْبِسْنَـا بِهِمَا لِبَاسَ الْبَلاَءِ.
transliteration: yabtadiraani taa'atak biraḥmatin naafi'atin aw naqimatin ḍaarratin fala tu'mṭirna bihima maṭar al-saw'i walā tulbisnā bihimā libāsa al-balāʾ
english_text: They rush to obey Thee with beneficial mercy or injurious vengeance, so rain not down upon us from them the evil rain and clothe us not through them in the garment of affliction!

arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا نَفْعَ هَذِهِ السَّحَائِبِ وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَاصْرِفْ عَنَّا أَذَاهَا وَمَضَرَّتَهَا، وَلا تُصِبْنَا فِيْهَا بآفَة،
transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa anzil ʿalayna nafʿa hadhihi as-sahāʾib wa barakataha waṣrif ʿannā aḏāhā wamaḍarrahā walā tuṣibnā fīhā bi-āfah
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, send down upon us the benefit of these clouds and their blessing, turn away from us their harm and their injury, strike us not through them with blight,

transliteration: wa lā tur-sil ʿalā maʿāyishi-nā ʿāha-tan
english_text: and loose not upon our livelihoods any bane!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كُنْتَ بَعَثْتَهَا نَقِمَةً وَأَرْسَلْتَهَا سَخْطَةً فَإنَّا نَسْتَجِيْرُكَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ، وَنَبْتَهِلُ إلَيْكَ فِي سُؤَالِ عَفْوِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa in kunt bʿath tahā naqimatan wa arsal tahā sakhtan fa'innā nastajīruka min ghaḍabika wa nabtahilu ilayka fi suali afwik
english_text: O God, if Thou hast incited them as vengeance and loosed them in anger, we seek sanctuary with Thee from Thy wrath and implore Thee in asking Thy pardon!

arabic_text: فَمِلْ بِالْغَضَبِ إلَى الْمُشْـركِينَ، وَأَدِرْ رَحَى نَقِمَتِـكَ عَلَى الْمُلْحِـدينَ.
transliteration: famir bil-ghaḍab ilā al-mushrikīn wa adir rahā naqimatik ʿalā al-mulhidīn
english_text: So incline with wrath toward the idolaters and set the millstone of Thy vengeance turning upon the heretics

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ أَذْهِبْ مَحْلَ بِلاَدِنَا بِسُقْيَاكَ، وَأَخْرِجْ وَحَرَ صُدُورِنَا بِرِزْقِكَ، وَلاَ تَشْغَلْنَا عَنْكَ بِغَيْرِكَ، وَلاَ تَقْطَعْ عَنْ كَافَّتِنَا مَادَّةَ بِرِّكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma adhhib maḥla bilādinā bi suqyāka wa'akhrij waḥara ṣudūrinā birizqik wa lā tašġalnā ʿank bighayrika wa lā taqṭaʿ ʿan kāffatinā māddata birrikah
english_text: O God, take away the barrenness of our lands with Thy watering, dislodge the malice from our breasts with Thy providing, distract us not from Thee through other than Thee, and cut none of us off from the stuff of Thy goodness,

arabic_text: فَإنَّ الغَنِيَّ مَنْ أَغْنَيْتَ، وَإنَّ السَّالِمَ مَنْ وَقَيْتَ،
transliteration: fa'innal-ghaniyya man agnayta wa-inna al-salima man waqayta
english_text: for the rich is he to whom Thou hast given riches, and the safe he whom Thou hast protected!

arabic_text: مَا عِنْدَ أَحَد دُونَكَ دِفَـاعٌ، وَلاَ بِأَحَد عَنْ سَطْوَتِكَ امْتِنَاعٌ،
transliteration: ma ʿinda ʾaḥad dūnaka difāʿun walā bi'aḥad ʿan satwatika imtināʿ
english_text: No one has any defense against Thee, nor any means to bar Thy penalty.

arabic_text: تَحْكُمُ بِمَا شِئْتَ عَلَى مَنْ شِئْتَ، وَتَقْضِي بِمَـا أَرَدْتَ فِيمَنْ أَرَدْتَ.
transliteration: taḥkumu bimā shi'ta ʿalā man shi'ta wa taqḍī bimā aradta fīman aradta
english_text: Thou decidest what Thou wilt for whom Thou wilt and Thou decreest what Thou desirest for any whom Thou desirest!

arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى مَا وَقَيْتَنَا مِنَ الْبَلاءِ، وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنَا مِنَ النّعْمَاءِ حَمْداً يُخَلِّفُ حَمْدَ الْحَامِدِينَ وَرَاءَهُ، حَمْداً يَمْلاُ أَرْضَهُ وَسَمَاءَهُ
transliteration: falaka al-ḥamdu ʿalā mā waqaīṭanā min al-balāʾi wa laka al-shukru ʿalā mā khawwaltnā mina al-naʿmāʾ ḥamdan yukhallifu ḥamda al-ḥāmidīn wa-rāʾahu ḥamdān yamlu arḍahu wa samāʾahu
english_text: So to Thee belongs praise for protecting us from affliction and to Thee belongs thanks for conferring upon us blessings, a praise which will leave behind the praise of the praisers, a praise which will fill the earth and the heaven!

arabic_text: إنَّـكَ الْمَنَّانُ بِجَسِيمِ الْمِنَنِ، الْوَهَّابُ لِعَظِيمِ النِّعَمِ، القَابِلُ يَسِيْرَ الْحَمْدِ، الشَّاكِرُ قَلِيْلَ الشُّكْرِ،
transliteration: 'innaka al-mannānu bi-jasīmi al-minan al-wahhābu liʿaẓīmi al-niʿami al-qabilu yasir al-hamd al-shākiru qalīla al-shukri
english_text: Surely Thou art the All-kind through immense kindnesses, the Giver of abounding favours, the Accepter of small praise, the Grateful for little gratitude,
the Beneficent, the Benevolent, Possessor of graciousness!

arabic_text: لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ إلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
transliteration: lā ʾilāha illā anta ʾilayka al-maṣīr
english_text: There is no god but Thou; unto Thee is the homecoming
